matrix.state_note: ngram-mod keeps its token pool across requests on one server (cleared at 25% occupancy), so a prompt sees the prompts and outputs of earlier prompts of the same server; the order is the seeded shuffle
matrix.checkpoint_note: the n-gram types get n_rs_seq = 0 from need_n_rs_seq() (common.h), so the hybrid target takes the KV-checkpoint path: a checkpoint per drafting step and a restore plus replay of the target pass on partial acceptance, which draft-simple (n_rs_seq = K) does not pay
